t: US Pragmatism Could Help Discussions Within G20 - Lavrov
d: The pragmatism characteristic of the Americans could help advance discussions among G20 participants this year, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said.

t: Ukraine's Public Debt Up 130-Fold in 20 Years - Statistics
d: Ukraine's total public debt, both external and domestic, has grown 130-fold since September 2006, according to statistical data analyzed by Sputnik.

t: Dialogue Between Russian, Ukrainian Ombudsmen Important for Human Rights Work - Kremlin
d: Russian Human Rights Commissioner Yana Lantratova and Ukrainian Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets have established a good dialogue, which is important for human rights activities, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Saturday.

t: Russia Advances Along Front Lines in Ukraine
d: The Ukrainian armed forces lost up to 340 soldiers, six armored vehicles and an electronic warfare station in combat against Russia's Tsentr battlegroup, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Saturday.

t: Iran’s Supreme Leader Vows Full-Spectrum Retaliation to Any Enemy Aggression
d: Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has directed the country’s armed forces to deliver an immediate and decisive response to any enemy attack, free from geographical restrictions, according to Iranian media reports.

t: Finland Pushes Its Military Buildup Further with Space Operations Center
d: The center will start operations on January 1, 2027, the Finnish Air Force announced. It will be located within the Finnish Air Force HQ in central Finland.

t: US Has No Specific Deadline for Making Deal With Iran - Rubio
d: The United States has no specific deadline for achieving agreements with Iran, with US President Donald Trump being the one to make decision on further actions, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday.
